title: The Gravitational Footprint of a Sister
quote: Some people don't realise how much space they occupy in the memories of others.

exhibits.heading: Things Worth Appreciating About Aarna
points: Your total inability to pretend to be someone else. You are 100% genuine, even when being completely silly.
The way your face lights up whenever you laugh from the stomach. It's instantly contagious.
Your underlying kindness that watches out for people quietly, without expecting applause or credit.
The fierce loyalty you give to those you call your own.

exhibits.heading: Small Moments That Made A Difference
points: School was often exhausting, competitive, and dull. Talking to you in between classes was the only part of the day that felt completely light and real.
The silent eye contact across the classroom during boring lectures. We never needed words to start cracking up.
The stolen tiffins and sharing of snacks—small rituals that made everyday school life feel like a shared adventure.
The effortless comfort of knowing someone understands your exact brand of humor without needing an explanation.

exhibits.heading: Things She May Not Realise People Appreciate
points: You make people feel safe being weird around you. That is a rare, magnetic superpower.
Even when you call yourself 'gawar' or act dramatic, you carry an effortless emotional intelligence that notices when someone is down.
You don't just exist in a room; you warm it up.
Having you as a sister-like friend in school changed how I experienced those years forever.

personalPostscript.author: From Your School Benchmate & Brother
personalPostscript.text: We lived our lives between the 8:00 AM bell and the 2:00 PM bell. We never hung out in the outside world. And yet, there is no one else from those halls whose friendship I treasure more deeply. You gave me the sister I never had.
